description: A feedback offer waits (Send this to the makers) and he says 'yes send it': the tutor takes it as a confirm, says in a sentence that it is done and promises nothing.

history.q: Can this work with Olive Tree?
history.a: Lampas does not work with Olive Tree. I can pass your wish to the makers; I cannot say what they will decide.

pending_offer.text: He wants Lampas to work with the Olive Tree app.
